source: 敵の小型戦艦 20 種類の追加用 90 枚 (シート 84〜93、画像はまだ無い)。塗装とマーク
style: Small hostile warships of the "Void fleet" in a stylised sci-fi space game: dark gunmetal, angular, worn, with glowing accent lights. PICTURE cells: ONE item or scene seen exactly straight on (or from directly above), filling the cell, flat even light, no readable text, letters, numbers or real-world logos. CUTOUT-style PICTURE cells say "on plain pure white background": draw only the object or emblem, centred, on flat pure white with no shadow. Tiles are flat, evenly lit and seamless.

cells.name: en-emblem-void
cells.prompt: An emblem: a dark circle eclipse with a jagged violet ring and three claw marks. On plain pure white background.

cells.name: en-emblem-command
cells.prompt: A gold winged star emblem with a dark centre, military insignia. On plain pure white background.

cells.name: en-emblem-pirate
cells.prompt: A pirate emblem: a stylised skull with crossed wrenches. On plain pure white background.

cells.name: en-kill-marks
cells.prompt: A row of painted kill tally marks: small dark red ship silhouettes with black outlines, five in a row. On plain pure white background.

cells.name: en-noseart-fang
cells.prompt: Nose art: a big painted mouth with sharp white fangs and red gums. On plain pure white background.

cells.name: en-noseart-bolt
cells.prompt: Nose art: a jagged yellow lightning bolt with black outline. On plain pure white background.

cells.name: en-paint-camo
cells.prompt: Splinter camouflage paint on metal: angular dark grey, purple-grey and black shapes.

cells.name: en-paint-stripes
cells.prompt: Red diagonal warning stripes painted on dark metal, chipped edges.

cells.name: en-id-lights
cells.prompt: A strip of small identification lights on a dark hull panel: red, white and violet, glowing.
